title: UK single release: Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band/With A Little Help From My Friends | 1978
content:
The Beatles’ ‘Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band’/‘With A Little Help From My Friends’ was released as a single in the United Kingdom on 22 September 1978.

It was issued to coincide with the release of the film Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band, which starred Peter Frampton and The Bee Gees.

The single was not a commercial success, peaking at number 63 on the UK singles chart. The b-side was ‘A Day In The Life’.

In the US it had fared even worse after its 14 August release. It reached number 71 on the Billboard Hot 100, and 92 on the Cash Box chart.
